dict.string: Ukacell uses the camera to scan the QR code shown by `npx ukacell`, and lets the app you are developing use it.
The app you are developing in Ukacell requested your location.
The app you are developing in Ukacell requested Face ID authentication.
The app you are developing in Ukacell requested to read or write NFC tags.
Ukacell connects to the dev server running on your computer over the local network.
